commits.message: Add review of copilot-generated Vault role guidance

Add Rocky Linux 10 and Ubuntu 24.04.3 templates with CIS compliance

- Introduced a new Kickstart configuration for Rocky Linux 10.
- Updated the Packer template for Rocky Linux 10 to include baseline security hardening and essential tools.
- Removed outdated Ubuntu 22.04 template and ISO.
- Added new user-data and meta-data files for Ubuntu 24.04.3 to support autoinstallation.
- Updated the Packer template for Ubuntu 24.04.3 with CIS compliance and essential system tools.
- Created example Packer variable configuration file for easier setup.
- Added preseed configuration for Debian 13 to automate installations.
- Cleaned up and organized HTTP server configurations for cloud-init.
- Updated project.json to reflect changes in template descriptions and versions.
feat: Update Packer template for Rocky Linux 10 with Ansible provisioning

feat: Remove legacy deploy script and add new Packer templates for Debian 13, Ubuntu 22.04, and Ubuntu 24.04.3

- Deleted the old deploy.sh script.
- Added new Packer templates for Debian 13 and Ubuntu 22.04 with Ansible provisioning.
- Created a new Packer template for Ubuntu 24.04.3 with Ansible provisioning.
- Updated project.json to include new templates and project structure.
- Added example Packer variables file for easier configuration.
- Removed outdated Packer configuration for Rocky Linux 9.

Refactor build-template.sh to improve output formatting and modularize functions

- Added color-coded output functions for better visibility.
- Modularized the script by creating functions for checking prerequisites, initializing Packer, showing templates, validating and building templates, and building all templates.
- Enhanced user interaction with a menu for selecting templates to build.
- Included success and failure messages for template validation and building processes.

Add Packer configuration for Debian 12 and Debian 13 templates

- Created new Packer configuration files for Debian 12 and Debian 13 with Ansible provisioning.
- Implemented preseed configuration for Debian 13 to automate installation.
- Added HTTP server configuration for preseed files.

Create Kickstart configuration for Rocky Linux 10

- Added a Kickstart configuration file for Rocky Linux 10 to automate installation.

Implement cloud-init user-data and meta-data for Ubuntu 24.04.3

- Created user-data and meta-data files for Ubuntu 24.04.3 to enable autoinstallation.

Add Packer configurations for Ubuntu 24.04.3 and Rocky Linux 9

- Created new Packer configuration files for Ubuntu 24.04.3 and Rocky Linux 9 with Ansible provisioning.

Add Ansible templates and deployment scripts for K3s and OpenTofu

- Create k3s-server-init.service.j2 and k3s-server-join.service.j2 for K3s service management.
- Implement build-template.sh for Packer template creation with Ansible provisioning.
- Develop deploy.sh for managing the deployment process, including infrastructure checks and actions.
- Add OpenTofu configuration files and modules for managing Proxmox VMs.
- Introduce Packer configurations for building Ubuntu 22.04 templates with Ansible integration.
- Include cloud-init configurations for automated VM setup during installation.
- Document usage and structure in README files for both Packer and OpenTofu.
